paper_title: Extensive search for axion dark matter over 1\,GHz with CAPP's Main Axion eXperiment
coupling_convention: GeV^-1 (g_agamma); paper reports model coupling g_gamma but numeric values not extractable from text
notes: CAPP-MAX cavity haloscope search for axion dark matter, 1.025-1.185 GHz (4.24-4.91 µeV). Sets exclusion limits on axion-photon coupling at ~90% CL assuming axions are 100% of local DM density (0.45 GeV/cm^3). The exclusion limit is presented in Fig. 22 but no numerical table of (mass, coupling) values is available in the provided text, so data_points cannot be reliably extracted. Mass range maps to 4.24e-6 to 4.91e-6 eV.
